what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Bangladesh in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6540 Bangladeshi asylum seekers in South Africa, 7.1% of all asylum seekers from Bangladesh.
Refugees from Bangladesh, a separate group, live mostly in France, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Bangladesh in 2005 and 2006, and with the Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 418 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 28347, at the end of 2019.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2021, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
